verdict.rationale: PostHog's own GitHub README says it can send event data in real time to 'any webhook', which is a first-party outbound HTTP event delivery capability. That is the only mention, and it is brief: there is no documentation of how to register a webhook, filter events, the payload format, or retry and delivery guarantees. missing for 10: webhook registration/subscription docs, event filtering details, payload schema, delivery/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Send it to 25+ tools or any webhook in real time
